world.description: Document-owned cell rows. These remain mutation-addressable through state:<name>.

body.description: Per-body ephemeral counters and timers, compiled into each body's bounded ordinal arrays.

identity.description: Per-body counters and timers synchronized through the durable identity-document seam.

lattices.description: The lattice topologies the section's lattice-shaped rows lie over (see WorldStateLatticeTopology).

items.description: One state.lattices topology -- the footprint, cadence, and reactions every lattice-shaped state row referencing it shares. At most one physical field topology and bounded discrete topologies may coexist.

name.description: The topology's name -- what a row's lattice.topology references.

cellSize.description: The cubic cell edge, world units.

layers.description: Cells along +Y -- 1 is a ground lattice.

reactions.description: The per-step reactions over a physical field topology, applied in document order.

items.description: One reaction — a local rule every cell (or every tagged body) applies each lattice step. Reactions run in document order; Diffuse reads the previous step's values for the whole field, every other kind reads and writes cells in place, row-major.

anyOf.description: Moves each cell a fraction of the way toward the mean of its face neighbours (four on a ground lattice, six in a volume).
Scales each cell toward zero: v -= v·rate.
Where every condition holds at a cell, applies every write at that cell — ignition, melting, evaporation, freezing are rows of this shape.

when.description: The conditions, all of which must hold.

items.description: One per-cell condition of a Transform.

field.description: The field read at the cell.

value.description: The scalar compared against (literal or state-row reference).

items.description: One per-cell write of a Transform.

field.description: The field written at the cell.

value.description: The constant written or added; the result clamps to the field's range.

anyOf.description: Every active body whose cell in the keyed state row Tag reads nonzero adds Amount to Field at the cell it occupies — a burning body is a heat source.

tag.description: The keyed int state row whose nonzero cells name the emitting bodies.

amount.description: The amount per step; the cell clamps to the field's range.

anyOf.description: Writes 1 or 0 into Row's cell for every active body, by whether Field at the body's cell satisfies the comparison — a body standing in a burning cell becomes tagged, and body-level chemistry takes it from there.

field.description: The field sampled at the body.

row.description: The keyed int state row written, keyed by body index.

anyOf.description: Moves Field downhill, cell to cell, over the combined surface height of Over plus Field's own value -- mass-conserving except where a cell's clamp to its declared [min, max] binds. Every cell donates an equal share of its previous-step value to each of the lattice's active-axis directions (four on a ground lattice, six in a volume -- the SAME count for every cell, whether a direction reaches a neighbour or the lattice edge), and sends that share only along a direction that is strictly downhill; a level or uphill direction moves nothing.

rate.description: The fraction of a cell's per-direction share that actually moves each step, in [0, 1].

over.description: The other lattice rows forming the terrain basis a downhill direction is measured against; empty or omitted means the field flows over its own height alone.

spillRow.description: The scalar fixed-kind state row an edge cell's outward share accumulates into each step (a clamped add), or null to treat every lattice edge as a wall.

kind.description: Physical fields or a discrete grid, ring, or axial hexagon.

wrap.description: Wrapped axes for a discrete grid; rings always wrap.

radius.description: The axial hexagon radius; zero for other kinds.

band.description: For a Grid, the vertical half-extent about the origin's Y a position must lie within to resolve to a cell (cellOf); 0 resolves any height, so a piece on the floor beneath a table still reads as on its square.

social.description: Optional bounded social-memory policy; learned runtime impressions are checkpoint state, not public cell rows.

dimensions.description: Independent, uniquely named impression dimensions. Values are normalized to [-1,1].

items.description: One contextual belief's authored bounds and learning behavior. Confidence is a game heuristic, not a calibrated probability. This is not a personality or mood model.

name.description: Non-empty dimension name; contexts, attempts, and outcomes may use distinct dimensions.

maximum.description: Upper normalized bound, at most 1, strictly greater than Minimum.

baseline.description: Value of an unknown impression, inside the bounds.

priorWeight.description: Positive inertia toward the current estimate, at most 1024.

weightCapacity.description: Maximum accumulated evidence weight, positive and at most 65536.

learningRate.description: [0,1] multiplier on value learning; zero locks the value but not evidence/confidence.

maximumChange.description: [0,2] maximum absolute value change per accepted event or direct-observation upgrade.

conflictThreshold.description: [0,2] distance from the current estimate above which fresh evidence is conflicting.

conflictGain.description: [0,1] maximum uncertainty increase, scaled by effective evidence strength.

consistencyGain.description: [0,1] maximum uncertainty decrease for consistent, independent evidence.

followUpBoost.description: [0,16] extra direct-evidence weight per unit uncertainty; does not boost repeated events.

confidenceDecaySeconds.description: Exact engine-tick duration for linear evidence-weight decay; zero disables it.

recoverySeconds.description: Exact engine-tick duration for linear value recovery to baseline; zero disables it.

impressionCapacity.description: Total retained (observer, subject, dimension) entries, not body capacity.

impressionsPerObserver.description: Maximum retained entries for one observer, across subjects and dimensions.

receiptCapacity.description: Exact duplicate-evidence ledger capacity. Unexpired receipts are never evicted.

evidenceAttemptsPerTick.description: Maximum ingestion attempts, including invalid and duplicate attempts.

expiredReceiptsPerTick.description: Maximum expired ledger entries reclaimed when the engine clock advances.

evidenceLifetimeSeconds.description: Positive exact engine-tick admission age. Older evidence is refused.

reliabilityDimension.description: Optional [0,1] dimension used to assess a report's source, independently of affection.

unfamiliarReliability.description: Fallback source reliability in [0,1], blended with learned reliability by confidence.

directWeight.description: Non-negative weight of a direct observation of quality one, at most 1024.

reportWeight.description: Non-negative report weight before quality and source reliability, at most 1024.
